name: Abyss
description: A slowly evolving drone and pad instrument: hold a note and it opens from a sine into a deep, moving pad. 24 drifting sine partials per voice with a wandering spectral bloom, detuned twins, sub, fifth and shimmer layers, air, a slow motion cycle (free or synced to the song) and a lush built-in reverb; 6 voices, 8 programs.
author: Groundswell
